question_text: AB and CD represent two parallel straight long conducting wires fixed to a horizontal plane carrying current $I$ in each of them. $L$ is a conducting square loop placed on the same horizontal plane. Consider the following statements and the figure shown between AB and CD. Towards the following statements are correct:

options.option_text: (A) The direction of the induced current in the loop is always clock-wise
(B) The induced current in the loop gradually increases as it is moved along the line XY
(C) The induced current in the loop speed is moving along the line XY
(D) The induced current in the loop is zero at the instant the line PQ of the loop passes through the centre of the wires
(1) only A is true, (2) only B is true, (3) only A, B and C are true, (4) only B and C are true, (5) only A, B, C and D are true
